name: Marvel's Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur
description: After 13-year-old super-genius Lunella accidentally brings ten-ton T-Rex, Devil Dinosaur into present-day New York City via a time vortex, the duo works together to protect the city's Lower East Side from danger.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Adaptations
videos.overview: Rock those adaptations! When the thieving Bone Raider robs the history museum, Moon Girl realizes it's time to put Devil Dinosaur's all-natural evolutions on display.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: States of Matter
videos.overview: When an evil evaporating villain seems ready to disappear into thin air, Moon Girl and Devil are determined to put a freeze on their plans.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Plants
videos.overview: When a neglected mutant plant attacks Casey, Moon Girl and Devil use the power of plant knowledge to stop a growing problem.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Forces and Motion
videos.overview: When the hot rodding robber Rockin' Rudy is getting away for the millionth time, Moon Girl and Devil use gravity to bring on his fall.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Light
videos.overview: When the nightmarish Nox tries to steal all the light from Coney Island, Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur work together to snuff out her plans.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Echolocation
videos.overview: When the fiendish Flying Fox steals in the subway, Moon Girl and Devil use the science of sound to stop the bat-like baddie.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Coding
videos.overview: When an evil villain threatens a community concert, Lunella teams up with supercomputer LOS to crack the code for saving the day.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Lab Shorts: Moon Girl Saves the Moon
videos.overview: When Beyonder puts the actual moon in peril, Lunella and Devil rocket to space in order to save earth's favorite nightlight.

videos.title: The Gatekeeper
videos.overview: Lunella and the Volleyball team get trapped in the locker room by the opposing team coach after she finds out that Brooklyn used to play on the boy's team.

videos.title: Moon Girl Landing
videos.overview: When brilliant, altruistic Lunella Lafayette accidentally brings a dinosaur to the Lower East Side, she finally has the brawn to match her brains and protect her community.

videos.title: The Borough Bully
videos.overview: When Lunella finds a nasty comment on her Moon Girl social media page, her fixation on the troll threatens to take over her life.

videos.title: Run the Rink
videos.overview: When Lunella runs the rink for a night, she agrees to Casey's get-rich-quick scheme, which threatens Moon Girl’s reputation and her family's beloved business.

videos.title: Check Yourself
videos.overview: When Lunella loses a game of chess against a supercomputer, her obsession with winning drives the frustrated computer to program every device in the school to attack her.

videos.title: Hair Today, Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: When Lunella creates a chemical to change her hair, she accidentally turns her mane into a vengeful villain that vows to ruin her.

videos.title: The Beyonder
videos.overview: The Beyonder gloms onto Lunella to learn about humanity, just as she's struggling to win a big science competition.

videos.title: Moon Girl's Day Off
videos.overview: When Lunella seemingly gets hurt and is stuck in bed, Casey must step in as Moon Girl for the day.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: When Devil Dinosaur gets jealous of sharing Lunella with her class hamster and accidentally sets the animal free, he must search New York City to bring the furry friend home.

videos.title: Skip This Ad…olesence
videos.overview: Lunella creates a device that allows her to fast forward through mundane chores and tasks, but she struggles to handle the unexpected side effects.

videos.title: Goodnight, Moon Girl
videos.overview: Lunella tries to overcome her awkwardness about fitting in at a slumber party by creating a mind-reading device but accidentally switches brains with Devil Dinosaur.

videos.title: Like Mother, Like Moon Girl
videos.overview: Moon Girl fights to save the LES from changing.

videos.title: Today, I Am a Woman
videos.overview: Hoping to help Casey have an epic bat mitzvah, Lunella makes an appearance as Moon Girl, which ultimately brings out the worst in Casey and causes a rift in their friendship.

videos.title: Devil on Her Shoulder
videos.overview: Feeling insecure about his size, Devil convinces Lunella to create a potion to make him temporarily small.

videos.title: Coney Island, Baby!
videos.overview: Lunella must confront her childhood fear, the Coney Island Funhouse, to save Mimi from The Beyonder.

videos.title: "OMG Issue #1"
videos.overview: Lunella uncovers the history of the Original Moon Girl as she struggles to thwart a powerful villain's plan to use her portal for evil.

videos.title: "OMG Issue #2"
videos.overview: Moon Girl faces her greatest challenge yet and puts everything on the line.

videos.title: The Great Beyond-Er!
videos.overview: When Moon Girl and The Beyonder become stranded on a desolate alien planet, the two set out to find a rumored black hole in hopes of getting home.

videos.title: Suit Up!
videos.overview: When Lunella tries to juice up her new super suit, she goes overboard and accidentally 'juices up' a dangerous desert scorpion.

videos.title: Belly of the Beast
videos.overview: When Devil Dinosaur eats a dangerous Moon Girl gadget, Lunella and Casey must shrink themselves to retrieve it.

videos.title: Ride or Die
videos.overview: When Moon Girl must transport Quickwhip to S.H.I.E.L.D., keeping the criminal in custody becomes harder than she imagined.

videos.title: Kid Kree
videos.overview: Moon Girl’s rivalry with a new teenage super-foe, Kid Kree, threatens her budding friendship with his human alter ego, Marvin.

videos.title: Wish-Tar
videos.overview: When The Beyonder gives an arcade machine the ability to grant wishes, Lunella is pumped to use it.

videos.title: Make It, Don't Break It!
videos.overview: When I.S. 833 gets an impressive science teacher, Lunella is so eager to impress her that her drive toward perfectionism starts doing more harm than good.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: When Lunella and Devil Dinosaur spend the weekend apart after a disagreement, Devil Dino gets mixed up with a rag-tag group of ex-Super Hero sidekicks.

videos.title: In the Heist
videos.overview: Lunella discovers that a stolen Kree artifact is about to cause a cataclysmic storm, but when none of the adults believe her, she must swipe it herself.

videos.title: Dog Day Mid-Afternoon
videos.overview: When Pops fosters a mysterious stray dog and enters him into a dog show, a paranoid Lunella is convinced the creature is an evil alien who intends to sabotage the event.

videos.title: Roller Jam!
videos.overview: When Pops' rivalry with former best friend and skate partner Vernell threatens to ruin Roller Jam, Lunella meddles in their beef to squash it.

videos.title: Dancing with Myself
videos.overview: Lunella is desperate to find a date to the school dance, but when she gets Kid Kree to be her escort, she learns that peer pressure can harm the relationships that matter most.

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: When Moon Girl teams up with the amazing Super Hero, Turbo, she realizes the true cost of keeping up a secret identity.

videos.title: The Molecular Level
videos.overview: After Lunella tells her family that she's Moon Girl, she must convince them she will be safe, which seems impossible when Molecule Man shows up for revenge.

videos.title: Moon Girl, Grounded
videos.overview: When Adria forbids Lunella from Moon Girl-ing, Lu must figure out how to defend the LES from a villainous crew, the Felonious Four.

videos.title: Ride Along
videos.overview: Eager to bond with her dad, Moon Girl takes James on a ride-along.

videos.title: Lava Actually
videos.overview: When being around the brilliant Hot Tomatoes leaves Pops feeling insecure, he dabbles in an elixir that makes him smart.

videos.title: Full Moon
videos.overview: Adria plans a special mother-daughter bonding day with Lunella.

videos.title: To Intervention and Beyond-er
videos.overview: Devil Girl instigates a friendship intervention between Moon Girl and The Beyonder, but emotional frustrations push the trickster’s powers to fritz.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: When Lunella discovers that Eduardo has a crush on her, she creates a fake boyfriend to spare his feelings.

videos.title: A Devil-ish Birthday
videos.overview: Devil Dinosaur gets two birthday parties.

videos.title: Party Girl
videos.overview: Moon Girl gets into the children's party business.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
videos.overview: The Beyonder comes to dinner.

videos.title: Shoot for the Moon
videos.overview: Moon Girl must make a life-changing decision.
